title: Create agents directly from Jira work items
description:
You can now create and configure agents without leaving your current work item. Select Create an agent from the Assignee or Agents field, and an agent plan will be drafted based on the work item context — ready for you to review, refine, and activate in seconds. Open a work item in Jira.
	In the Assignee or Agents field, select Create an agent.
	An agent plan is drafted based on the work item context.
	Review the suggested name and instructions, then edit if needed.
